result: No public unauthenticated request-to-latency interface was found in the checked source/docs. A request label alone does not identify or prove the upstream model for a particular handled request.

verified_facts.fact: The local LiteLLM pre-call hook uses a valid x-litellm-call-id as request_id for proxy-master requests; otherwise it generates a local trace UUID.
Each provider attempt gets a distinct attempt_id and stores request_id, api_path, role, provider_id, upstream_model, created_at, and later an outcome plus updated_at in subroute_usage_receipts.
Streaming usage observation records provider usage and terminal outcome, but does not record first-token time.
Success hook accepts start_time/end_time arguments but does not persist them as receipt timing fields.

Dynamic routing preserves the originally requested model in metadata and stamps that requested value back onto client-visible responses/stream events; client-visible model identity is therefore not proof of the upstream provider/model.
The checked control API exposes source status and provider usage only; no request receipt lookup, queue wait, TTFT, or request latency endpoint was found there.

verified_facts.observed: GET http://127.0.0.1:4000/health/liveliness returned HTTP 200; response body not inspected
verified_facts.fact: The source-verified local health route returned HTTP 200, which confirms liveness only and carries no request-level timing/correlation evidence.
The repository contains a queued/running task state machine for its separate Relay task service; this is not evidence of a queue for Subroute model inference requests.

not_established: Whether a particular recent frontend request reached Subroute, completed, or fell back to another provider/model.
Whether the frontend label anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 was the requested alias, routed upstream model, or a UI-only label for any specific request.
The relationship between a frontend event and a stored Subroute request_id unless both share an observed request/call ID.
Per-request TTFT, provider queue wait, or total latency from an existing public uncredentialed interface.
The cause of the reported slow completion. No request-specific runtime receipt was read and no provider request was made.
adoptable_diagnostic_action: For a future authorized request, preserve a request-scoped correlation ID from the client/response if the client already exposes one, then obtain only the matching sanitized request and attempt metadata through an existing owner-authorized receipt/log path. Compare requested label with recorded provider_id/upstream_model and created/updated terminal times. Without a common ID and readable sanitized receipt, mark correlation and latency unknown. No such public read path was verified in this review.
scope_limits: Read repository instructions, source and docs only; inspected one public unauthenticated liveness status.
No prompt, transcript, raw provider response, environment, credential, or authenticated admin log was read.
No provider ping, model request, config change, restart, or source edit was performed.
